title: I made a GRRM game where you finish Winds of Winter
author: apouriliaee
selftext:
I've been sitting on this one for a while but figured maybe others would get a kick out of it.

Aims to be arcade style with combos and such.  There's no real leaderboard at this time but if people dig on it I was thinking it'd be fun to see a leaderboard of the stories.

For now though, you get to play as GRRM and create or kill plotholes, gain good or bad reviews from your choices and build a bonus for writing the book faster, but watch out for George's blood pressure.  If it gets too high and he pops his top, it's game over.

Can George finish the Winds of Winter?  You get to write that story <3

Made with Google Flash and some Pro, but mostly Flash 3.5 if memory serves.  I'm a heavy user of the antigravity ecosystem ✊ 

Lmk what you think of the game and feel free to check out my profile for other bits.

comments.author: Felfedezni
comments.body: Oh no his poor old ticker gave out while writing at 88wpm.
